Are there health benefits to drinking your own urine?
response: No—there are no scientifically proven health benefits to drinking your own urine. Urine is a waste product that contains salts, urea, and other substances the body is trying to eliminate. Drinking it can lead to dehydration, electrolyte imbalances, and exposure to bacteria or toxins, especially if you have a urinary‑tract infection. If you’re looking for ways to stay hydrated or support your health, stick with safe, evidence‑based options (water, balanced nutrition, regular medical care) and talk to a healthcare professional before trying any unconventional practices.
